result.name: QFORM-RANK2-CROSS-PLUS-RANK1-SAME-SIDE-FRESNEL-v1
result.statement: For an original-source partition I,J,K, after conditioning K, if A_IJ has rank two with singular values s1,s2, A_JJ=D+eps*w*w^T with D diagonal in original J coordinates, and augmented source rows a_j=(s1 V_j1,s2 V_j2,w_j) have positive Gram G and normalized leverage at most 1/2, then |phi_Q(t)| <= 16*pi^(5/2)*det(G)^(-1/2)*|t|^(-5/2) and ||p_Q||_infinity <= (5/3)*2^(8/5)*det(G)^(-1/5). The density is continuous on this branch.
result.provenance_guard: The 2D projected pair is used only through its joint density cap <=2. It is never treated as independent. All Brascamp-Lieb Fourier factorisation remains on the original J source coordinates.
result.target_stress_family: A_m=[[0,CV^T],[VC^T,ww^T]] with diffuse Walsh C,V,w on two disjoint source banks has nonzero spectrum {1,1,1,-1,-1}, G=I3 and density bound (5/3)*2^(8/5)=5.0523885550346606 for arbitrary independent cap-one laws while physical entries/minors vanish polynomially in m.

completed_results_used: twisted characteristic-function Lp estimate int |g_hat|^p <= 4*pi/sqrt(p), p>=2, for |g|<=f<=1

designated_partner.interface: Partner r30 leaves two balanced source banks with small longitudinal innovations relative to their transverse two-row spans. The exact determinant identity proves that a one-bank rank-one Fresnel compiler degenerates exactly on that small innovation.

first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-TWO-BANK-COUPLED-INNOVATION-FRESNEL-v1: couple both r30 source banks so that the oscillatory determinant is paid by inter-bank slope separation / cross-third-volume rather than either small innovation alone, while retaining same-side curvature and product provenance.
